facts.fact: Daley 转述：Vedra 的声音叫他先去 Glennafar，再去 Greenwrack，说完两人就都不见了。
facts.anchor: They said to go to someplace called Glennafar

facts.fact: Mud Boy 说 Glennafar 是 Greenwrack 与 Silverway 之间一条又长又窄的峡谷，那地方名声不好。
facts.anchor: It’s a long, narrow gorge between the Greenwrack and the Silverway

facts.fact: Edgar 顶 Father Gwynn：Ewain 未加冕就不算王子，他们谁都不是奴隶，他信 Flann。
facts.anchor: he is no prince, and we are none of us slaves

facts.fact: Bellicent 在营中看见一顶孤零零的帐篷，离它最近的是 Scaeth 的帐，一百肘内别无他物。
facts.anchor: a single tent stood far from the others

facts.fact: 离开时 Bellicent 看见孤帐门帘掀开，里面似有一张惨白的脸，帘子随即合上。
facts.anchor: The flap of the tent had opened, a long, stripe of black

facts.fact: Xaniko 胸前插着一支箭，Vedra 判断硬拔只会加重伤势。
facts.anchor: The arrow still stood out from Xaniko’s breast like a sprouted sapling

facts.fact: Xaniko 要 Liam「当熊」去找蜜，Liam 坐到花丛里不动，约一小时后带回一块蜂巢。
Flann 定下：等到明天，若三人仍未到就派人回 Ardkillan 找，其余人继续前进。
facts.anchor: the rest of us will continue on
